body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-11-07 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "Our internal aspiration is that long term, we should be having an order mix of 50-50 ... But I think it will take us at least 2, 3 years to get there." Metric: Export share of order book. Target: ~50% (25% developed, 25% developing markets). Deadline: FY28 (2-3 yrs from Nov-2025; 'at least'). Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Next call (Jan-26): 'difficult for me to put in a timeline'. Apr-26: 'about 25% and then eventually 50%'. Aug-26: 'I can't say by when'. Export share of order book was 10% (Mar-26), 17% (Sep-26).

body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-07-29 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "the net working capital, which is today 128 days will probably come down to 110 days is what we are still committing" Metric: Net working capital days (company). Target: 110 days. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Mar-26 ~137 days (analyst figure in Q4FY26 call, not disputed); the CEO's answer then was 'I thought we said 110 days' - now for Mar-27. Jan-26 had already moved to '110 to 115'. Explanation given: water dues, metro back-ended payments, Saudi 20% retention, strategic inventory (prompted)
